```{r Load libraries}
library (Seurat)
library (plotly)
library (ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r Load input}
RBC <- readRDS(file = "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/paom/hemoglobin_containing_dataset_hardCO_edit2.rds")
```

# DEGs
##############################################################################################################################################################
## Hard cut-off
##### early_high_HBB
##### early_high_HBG
##### int_high_HBB
##### int_high_HBG
##### late_high_HBB
##### late_high_HBG
```{r}
DefaultAssay(RBC) <- "RNA"
Idents(RBC) <- "hardCO"
table(RBC@meta.data$hardCO)
```

### HBB vs HBG
### Find DEGs by early_high_HBB compare to early_high_HBG
```{r}
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers <- FindMarkers(RBC, ident.1 = "early_high_HBB", ident.2 = "early_high_HBG", logfc.threshold = 0, base = 2, min.pct = 0.25)
head(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers, n = 10)

#Convert avg_log2FC to avg_logFC
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers$avg_value <- 2^(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers$avg_log2FC)
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers$avg_logFC <- log(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers$avg_value, base = exp(1))

#Save table
write.csv(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers, "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/Hard_Cutoff/new2023_earlyHBBHBGhigh_hardCO_minpct0.25.markers.csv")
```
#### 20% and 50% Difference early_high_HBB vs early_high_HBG
```{r}
#20% Difference
log1.2 <- log(1.2, base = exp(1))
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 <- earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers %>% filter(p_val_adj<0.05) %>% arrange(avg_logFC) %>% filter(avg_logFC>log1.2)
write.csv(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20, "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/Hard_Cutoff/new2023_earlyHBBHBGhigh_hardCO_20diff_minpct0.25.markers.csv")

#50% Difference
log1.5 <- log(1.5, base = exp(1))
earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_50 <- earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers %>% filter(p_val_adj<0.05) %>% arrange(avg_logFC) %>% filter(avg_logFC>log1.5)
write.csv(earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_50, "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/Hard_Cutoff/new2023_earlyHBBHBGhigh_hardCO_50diff_minpct0.25.markers.csv")
```

# TF-DEGs
```{r}
gene_symbol <- read.delim("/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/gene_symbol_table.tsv")
#TF_table <- read.csv("/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/DatabaseExtract_v_1.01.txt", sep = "\t")
human_tf_db<-read_tsv("/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/DatabaseExtract_v_1.01.txt", col_types = list(col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character(),col_character()))
colnames(human_tf_db)<-c("ensembl_gene_id","HGNC_symbol","DBD","Is_TF","TF_assessment","Binding_mode","Motif_status","Final_Notes","Final_Comments","interpro_IDs","EntrezGene_ID","EntrezGene_Description","PDB_ID","TF_tested_by_HT-SELEX","TF _tested_by_PBM","Conditional_Binding_Requirements","Original_Comments","Vaquerizas_2009_classification","CisBP considers_it_a_TF","TFCat_classification","Is_a_GO_TF","Initial_assessment","Curator_1","Curator_2","TFclass_considers it_a_TF","Go_Evidence","Pfam_Domains_By_ENSP_ID")

```

## Filter TF

### HBB vs HBG
### 20% Difference
#### Hard Cut-off
```{r}
TF_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 <- earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>% 
  left_join(gene_symbol, by=c("rowname"="external_gene_name")) %>% 
  left_join(human_tf_db,by=("ensembl_gene_id")) %>% 
  filter(Is_TF=="Yes")
write.csv(TF_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20, 
          "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/Hard_Cutoff/new2023_TF_earlyHBBHBGhigh_hardCO_20diff_minpct0.25.markers.csv")
TF_intHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 <- intHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>% 
  left_join(gene_symbol, by=c("rowname"="external_gene_name")) %>% 
  left_join(human_tf_db,by=("ensembl_gene_id")) %>% 
  filter(Is_TF=="Yes")
write.csv(TF_intHBBHBGhigh.markers_20, 
          "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/Tables/Hard_Cutoff/new2023_TF_intHBBHBGhigh_hardCO_20diff_minpct0.25.markers.csv")
#filter tf
TF_lateHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 <- lateHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>% 
  left_join(gene_symbol, by=c("rowname"="external_gene_name")) %>%
```

```{r load dataset}
integrated_seurat <- readRDS(file = "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/paom/hemoglobin_containing_dataset_hardCO_edit2.rds")
```

```{r create average expression table}
DefaultAssay(integrated_seurat) <- "RNA"
Idents(integrated_seurat) <- "softCO"
```

```{r}
integrated_average_expression_table_RNA
```

```{r}
library(starsExtra)
#early_HBB vs early_HBG
soft_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 <- rownames_to_column(soft_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20, var = "gene_id")
top10_soft_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 <- soft_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 %>% slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_logFC) #%>%  extract2("gene_id")
top10_soft_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20 <- top10_soft_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20$gene_id
```

```{r}
top10_soft_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20
```

```{r}
library(fastcluster)
#early_HBB vs early_HBG
soft_early_HBBhigherthanHBG_table <- integrated_average_expression_table_RNA %>% 
  filter(rowname %in% 
           top10_soft_earlyHBBHBGhigh.markers_20) %>% 
  cbind.data.frame(group="early_HBBhigherthanHBG_allgene")

soft_early_HBBhigherthanHBG_matrix <- soft_early_HBBhigherthanHBG_table %>% 
  dplyr::select(-group) %>% 
  column_to_rownames() %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  t %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t %>% 
  as.matrix()

soft_early_HBBhigherthanHBG_hclust <- soft_early_HBBhigherthanHBG_matrix %>% 
  hclust.vector(method="ward", 
                metric="euclidean")

soft_early_HBBhigherthanHBG_table_sorted <- soft_early_HBBhigherthanHBG_table[soft_early_HBBhigherthanHBG_hclust$order,] %>% 
  cbind.data.frame(idx=seq(1:nrow(.))) %>% 
  remove_rownames()
```

### lazy heatmap function
```{r}
make_lazyheatmap2<-function(matrix_or_interest,heatmap_name,name){Heatmap(matrix_or_interest, 
                        #heatmap internal name
                        name=name,
                        #column ordering and dendogram config
                        show_column_dend = FALSE,
                        cluster_columns = FALSE,
                        #row ordering and dendrogram config
                        show_row_dend = FALSE, 
                        cluster_rows = FALSE,
                        #title config
                        column_title = heatmap_name,
                        #row and column name config
                        show_row_names = TRUE, 
                        show_column_names = TRUE,
                        column_names_side = "top",
                        row_names_side = "left", 
                        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
                        #color scale config
                        col = colorRamp2(c(-1.5,0,1.5), c("blue","black","yellow")),
                        #borderconfig
                        #rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 2),
                        #split=5
                        #set legend
              
                        #split=splitter,
                        use_raster = FALSE,
                        #annotation
                        #top_annotation = column_annotation_object
                        column_names_rot = 45,
                        width = unit(40, "mm")
                        )
  
}
```

## Soft Cut-off
#### Heatmap RNA early_HBB vs early_HBG
```{r}
temp_heatmap <- make_lazyheatmap2(matrix_or_interest = all_gene_table_sorted %>% 
                                    filter(time=="early") %>% 
                                    dplyr::select(-direction, -time, -type, -idx) %>% 
                                    column_to_rownames() %>% 
                                    #as.numeric() %>%
                                    as.matrix() %>% 
                                    t %>% 
                                    scale() %>% 
                                    t %>% 
                                    as.matrix(), 
                                  "Relative average transcription levels of\n differentially expressed genes (DEGs)\n between the 'early' HBB- or HBG-high groups", 
                                  name="z-score")
# 1. Open jpeg file
png("/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/paom/Figures/13-1_soft_early_HBBvsHBG.png", width = 5, height = 7, units = "in",  res = 600, bg ="white")
# 2. Create the plot
draw(temp_heatmap + Heatmap(all_gene_table_sorted %>% 
                              filter(time=="early") %>% 
                              dplyr::select(direction) %>% 
                              mutate_if(is.character,
                                        str_replace_all, pattern = "HBBhigherthanHBG", replacement = "HBB > HBG") %>%
                              mutate_if(is.character,
                                        str_replace_all, pattern = "HBGhigherthanHBB", replacement = "HBG > HBB"),
                            name="direction",
                            col=c("black", "grey"), 
                            width = unit(5, "mm")),
     heatmap_legend_side="right",
     padding = unit(c(5, 3, 3, 3), "mm")
     )
# 3. Close the file
dev.off()
```

```{r}
png("/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/paom/Figures/16-1_hard_early_HBBvsHBG_TF.png", width = 5, height = 5.3, units = "in",  res = 600, bg ="white")
# 2. Create the plot
draw(temp_heatmap + Heatmap(all_hardCO_gene_table_sorted_tf %>% 
                              filter(time=="early") %>% 
                              dplyr::select(direction) %>% 
                              mutate_if(is.character,
                                        str_replace_all, pattern = "HBBhigherthanHBG", replacement = "HBB > HBG") %>% 
                              mutate_if(is.character,
                                        str_replace_all, pattern = "HBGhigherthanHBB", replacement = "HBG > HBB"), 
                            name="direction", col=c("black", "grey"), 
                            width = unit(5, "mm")),
     heatmap_legend_side="right",
     padding = unit(c(5, 3, 3, 3), "mm")
     )
dev.off()
```
